title: handwriter texo checkpoints
description: Private: Texo (alephpi/FormulaNet, AGPL-3.0) base weights + handwriter fine-tuned checkpoints on MathWriting (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): v1 (5k subset), v2 best (epoch 2, human train), v3 best (epoch 4, human + synthetic inks with stroke augmentation; deepcopy test beam4 lp0 62.55% exact), and v4 best (epoch 2 of a 3-epoch colour-InkML run; colour test beam4 lp0 63.98% exact; not for photos). Plus handwriter code (color_mix, human_image_prob, eval-plain-images).
